notes: «عن أبيه، سعيد بن فلان» : «أبيه» is a relation followed by a name, so the link is the name alone (rule 7).
The gloss «هو عمرو بن سعيد بن العاص» is an editor's identification and is left out; «فلان» stays as written.
Umm Khalid is the Companion whose account is the saying, so she ends the chain.
